arg.name: hostname
arg.description: Hostname or IP address of the robot

arg.name: username
arg.description: Username for the robot web UI

arg.name: password
arg.description: Password for the robot web UI

arg.name: wait_web_ui
arg.description: Wait in case the robot web UI is currently in use

arg.name: request_physical_access
arg.description: Request control by confirming physical access to the robot in case the robot web UI is currently in use

arg.name: namespace
arg.description: Namespace of the node, e.g. "robot1" or "cell_a/robot1"
